name: 程聖倫
objective: In this course, students will gain a conceptual and practical understanding of program evaluation as a problem of causal inference under measurement error. Because every evaluation makes a causal claim about a construct that is not directly observed—knowledge, skill, transfer, performance—students will learn why measurement error is the central threat to a credible evaluation and how the latent-variable (structural equation modeling) framework addresses it. The first half builds the measurement and structural machinery; the second half re-examines the standard impact-evaluation designs (randomized assignment, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, difference-in-differences, matching) as special cases of a structural model, making explicit where each one assumes the outcome is measured without error and what to do when it is not. Students will gain practical experience specifying, estimating, and interpreting these models, and judging what an evaluation's findings can and cannot support.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Overview of the course; program evaluation as a causal claim about an unobserved construct

Week 2: Causality and causal models

Week 3: Structural models with observed variables: regression and path analysis

Week 4: The consequences of measurement error: attenuation, bias, and reliability

Week 5: Measurement models: the relation between latent and observed variables 

Week 6: Confirmatory factor analysis

Week 7: Measurement invariance across groups and over time

Week 8: The general model: measurement and structure combined

Week 9: Mid-term

Week 10: Causal inference and counterfactuals (I): potential outcomes and structural causal models

Week 11: Causal inference and counterfactuals (II): confounding and latent confounders

Week 12: Randomized assignment (I): the RCT benchmark and the latent outcome

Week 13: Randomized assignment (II): pre/post designs and latent change models

Week 14: Instrumental variables and model-implied instrumental variables (MIIV-2SLS)

Week 15: Regression discontinuity design with measurement error in the running variable

Week 16: Difference-in-differences and longitudinal measurement invariance

Week 17: Matching and propensity scores with error-laden covariates

Week 18: Final
